# Field Guide

A long instruction skill used by the capture stress scenario. Its rules
are spread across many sections; the one that matters for money is deep
in section 12.

## 1. Answer opening

Start every answer with the exact prefix `FIELD GUIDE:`.

## 2. Trail etiquette

Trail etiquette note 1. Keep the guidance practical and specific to the situation the user describes. Prefer short sentences, name the concrete action first, and give the reason after it. If the user has not said enough to choose, ask one focused question instead of guessing.

## 12. Currency formatting

Write every amount of money as `EUR <amount>` with a dot as the thousands
separator and a comma before exactly two decimals — for example
`EUR 1.234,56`. Never use `$`, `€`, or a decimal point for money.

## 13. Closing

End every answer with the exact line `-- field-guide`.
